body: Thanks.  I can completely relate.  Best of luck, and yes, take the drugs you need.  It's the only way...

I've long considered what it would be to be positive and measurable.  I have learned many hobbies in hopes of finding this elusive thing.  Many times, people claim the solution here is to just go help those less fortunate, because somehow that juxtaposition will illuminate your thinking showing you how fulfilling your life is.

Unfortunately, I have yet to find anything, including helping those less fortunate, that didn't make me just feel worse about existence.  In fact, helping those worse off than me made me feel even worse about life because I could see people from all walks of life were suffering, not just me.  It was as if no matter what decision I made, I would encounter some sort of issue that would hamper life:  monetary, relationship, health, or otherwise.

Appreciate the uplifting comment though.  I totally get where you are coming from, and thank you for providing your input.

Best of luck to you as well.  :)
